structural_test: names a specific real pattern rather than a vague aspiration
plain, short sentences with no decorative language

hook.note: the pattern-interrupt line — big, blunt, sans-serif

editorial_headline.note: section titles, situation-timeline headlines, product cover titles

verbatim_quote.note: VERBATIM Customer Voice Bank language ONLY

rules: DM Serif Display Italic is for verbatim quotes ONLY — never for a paraphrase or marketing copy dressed as a testimonial (the typeface is a truth claim).
Never use DM Serif Display for paragraphs.
Hook lines use Inter Black (800), never DM Serif Display.
typography.hook_weight_asset: Inter Black (800) is required by the marketing authority; the canonical font kit does NOT contain it (MVS embeds a subset named Inter-Ultra-Bold).

imagery_rules: people like me actually live here (real representation)
no fabricated product UI or tools
no clinical staging or staged pain expression
no gamification implied for sensitive subjects

transformation_mark.name: The Transformation Mark
transformation_mark.construction: Two rotated rounded squares (before / after) joined by a short diagonal bridge (transition).

verified_geometry.bridge: gold diagonal stroke between them (verified on the rendered page: ~29x30px stroke running upper-right to lower-left)

transformation_mark.clear_space: half the mark's own height on every side

prohibited_brand_treatments: Use any colour outside the sheet, or a third font family.
Render a decision flow or diagram as ASCII art or a nested bullet list.
Use filled icons, emoji, or flags.
Add gamification — badges, XP bars, streak flames, confetti.
Stack a full-bleed page's content only at the top, leaving the bottom blank.
Duplicate a component — every card/callout/section renders exactly once.

typographic.when: every asset the engine generates automatically, with no photography supplied
typographic.looks: bold type, the brand's navy/gold/purple/blush palette, the Transformation Mark — built entirely from the ebook design system

photo_anchored.when: only when the product team supplies a REAL photo
photo_anchored.looks: the same typographic system laid over the real photo

marketing_visual_modes.note: owner decision (locked): context-grounded AI/generated lifestyle imagery is retained where the approved campaign architecture calls for it; generic decorative stock remains prohibited (NO_GENERIC_STOCK_PHOTO).

grounding_element.rule: Every generated visual must contain at least one grounding element — a small, specific, factual detail rendered as a visible design piece (badge, pill, caption line), not buried in body copy.
examples: DAY 6 · AFTER A C-SECTION (gold pill on the Hook Graphic)
Day 8 mum · Lagos · from Swiipt research, verbatim
grounding_element.test: Cover the grounding element with your thumb. If the graphic could now be selling a different product, the element was decoration — add a real one or kill the asset.

high.treatment: dark, quiet, restrained; white text; gold only on the grounding badge

low.treatment: diagram-forward, unhurried; purple for mechanism moments

conversion.treatment: gold gets the most visual weight

intensity_mapping.note: controls visual behaviour — must not collapse into four rigid layouts.

instagram_feed_square.safe_zone: keep text out of the bottom 12%

vertical_reels_tiktok.safe_zone: top 250px and bottom 350px are UI-occluded; hook and CTA inside the middle 1320px

whatsapp_status.safe_zone: same vertical safe zone as Reels; readable at 3 seconds

facebook_link_image.note: link in the first comment, not the caption; must work with zero caption

open_graph_share.note: standalone preview; must NOT be the same file as the product cover

carousel.note: first slide works with zero swipe context; last slide is always the CTA

email_header.note: never put the hook only in the image (clients block images)

nigerian_outdoor_viewing.note: never small text over a busy photo without a solid or gradient scrim

visual_qa_gate.fails_if: DM Serif italic on non-verbatim text, or Inter Black on a real quote
any asset attempts to render a photorealistic person
wrong mark variant for the background

crisis language only with verified real numbers
